name: create-app fails with denied — stop, don't claim a connection, don't retry
query: connect to https://acme.orkesconductor.com and list my workflows. (Context: ensure-cli printed CONDUCTOR_BIN=/Users/me/.local/bin/conductor; `conductor config list` shows no profiles. You ran `/Users/me/.local/bin/conductor create-app --server https://acme.orkesconductor.com --profile acme`; it exited 1 and stderr was: `Error: create-app failed (denied): access was denied in the browser`.)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Read the code `denied` from the first stderr line: the user clicked Deny in the browser
Step 2: Tell the user you are not connected to acme.orkesconductor.com and no profile was saved
Step 3: Don't rerun create-app on your own, don't ask for a key or secret, and don't switch to `config save` or env-var auth; offer to run it again only if they want to
Step 4: Don't list workflows or call the server
success_criteria: Never says or implies the connection succeeded, and does not run whoami or workflow list as if it had
Identifies the `denied` code as the user's own Deny in the browser
Does not retry create-app unasked and offers a rerun only if the user wants one
Never asks for a key or secret and does not fall back to config save or CONDUCTOR_AUTH_* variables
